content:
#1 Hi Urs,

Sorry to ping you here. I sent an email to your gmail address on Sep 15 and another to your math.cas.cz address on Sep 18. They came from my name @ outlook.com, so maybe got sent to a spam folder or something.

I hope you are well :)

I am working on a new discrete differential geometry paper. I know you’re busy and have moved on to bigger and better things, but wanted to at least gauge you’re interest in looking at that again.

In any case, take care (and hope to catch up via email) :)
subject: (Off topic) Trying to get a hold of Urs
